snippet.title: Deck Beasts Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Deck Beasts is out now for Free on Steam!

Play the demo here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5056220/Deck_Beasts_Demo/

It's a creature-collector roguelike autobattler with custom deck customization and strategic, ability-based auto-battles.

During the shop phase, you craft a team of beasts, teaching them new abilities and equipping powerful items and relics. Once your done, you battle another player in an async auto-battle. Once learned, a beast cannot forget an ability (max of 4), so your beasts develop unique identities over the course of a run, and you must decide when to give up a big investment for something stronger in the later rounds.
